title: Nie Xiaoqian
synopsis: This is the second part of our rendition of Pu SongLing’s short story “Nie Xiaoqian”.

fullText.simplified:
小倩（二）

    宁采臣问燕赤霞知不知道他们的死因，燕赤霞认为这是鬼干的。宁采臣为人正直，根本不信有鬼，也就没有把燕赤霞的话放在心上。
    晚上，小倩又来找宁采臣。她对他说：“我见过很多人，但从来没有见过像你这样正直的人。你的确是个好人，我不敢骗你。其实我不是人，我是鬼。我十八岁的时候就病死了，我的坟就在这座寺庙的旁边。我被这里的树妖威胁，他要我用我的美貌去迷惑别人，然后把他们杀了，取他们的血给他喝。我其实并不想害人，我是被树妖威胁的。现在这寺庙中就剩你和燕赤霞了，树妖很可能要来杀你！”
    宁采臣听后吓得直发抖，他问小倩他应该怎么办。小倩说：“你只要和燕赤霞住在一起，就不会有事了。”
    宁采臣感到很奇怪：“你为什么不去迷惑燕赤霞？”
    “他是一个奇人，我不敢靠近他。”小倩回答道。
    “你是怎么迷惑人的？”宁采臣似乎有问不完的问题。
    小倩说：“好色的人，我就用我的美貌迷惑他，然后用锥子刺他的脚，取他的血来给树妖喝。喜欢钱的人，我就给他金子。其实那不是金子，它可以取人的心。”
    宁采臣听后发抖得更厉害了，忙问：“树妖什么时候会来？”
    “明天晚上。”小倩停了一下，又继续说道：“公子，我有一个小小的请求，不知您能否答应？”
    宁采臣点点头：“说来听听。”
    小倩低着头，哭着说：“我被树妖威胁，干了许多坏事。我没有办法救我自己，但公子你是一个正直的人，你一定能救我。”
    “我很想救你，但我只是一个普普通通的人，我要怎么做才能救你呢？”宁采臣觉得小倩很可怜。
    小倩说：“如果你能把我的坟带到别处，我就不用受到树妖的威胁了。我的坟就在这寺庙的北面。”
    宁采臣答应了。小倩很感激地看着宁采臣，转身走了。
    第二天，宁采臣请燕赤霞去喝酒，并请求晚上和他住在一起。燕赤霞刚开始不同意，但经不住宁采臣一而再再而三的苦苦请求，只好同意了。
    晚上，宁采臣来到燕赤霞的房间。燕赤霞对他说：“宁公子，我知道你是一个正直的人。您想和我住，可以。但我希望你不要碰这个小箱子，否则，对你对我都不好。”宁采臣答应了。
    燕赤霞把这个带锁的小箱子放在窗边，就去睡觉了，不一会儿，就睡着了。而宁采臣因为害怕，怎么也睡不着。到了晚上九点，窗户上出现了一个巨大的影子。慢慢地，影子越来越近了。
（未完待续）
fullText.traditional:
小倩（二）

    寧采臣問燕赤霞知不知道他們的死因，燕赤霞認為這是鬼幹的。寧采臣為人正直，根本不信有鬼，也就沒有把燕赤霞的話放在心上。
    晚上，小倩又來找寧采臣。她對他說：“我見過很多人，但從來沒有見過像你這樣正直的人。你的確是個好人，我不敢騙你。其實我不是人，我是鬼。我十八歲的時候就病死了，我的墳就在這座寺廟的旁邊。我被這裡的樹妖威脅，他要我用我的美貌去迷惑別人，然後把他們殺了，取他們的血給他喝。我其實並不想害人，我是被樹妖威脅的。現在這寺廟中就剩你和燕赤霞了，樹妖很可能要來殺你！”
    寧采臣聽後嚇得直發抖，他問小倩他應該怎麼辦。小倩說：“你只要和燕赤霞住在一起，就不會有事了。”
    寧采臣感到很奇怪：“你為什麼不去迷惑燕赤霞？”
    “他是一個奇人，我不敢靠近他。”小倩回答道。
    “你是怎麼迷惑人的？”寧采臣似乎有問不完的問題。
    小倩說：“好色的人，我就用我的美貌迷惑他，然後用錐子刺他的腳，取他的血來給樹妖喝。喜歡錢的人，我就給他金子。其實那不是金子，它可以取人的心。”
    寧采臣聽後發抖得更厲害了，忙問：“樹妖什麼時候會來？”
    “明天晚上。”小倩停了一下，又繼續說道：“公子，我有一個小小的請求，不知您能否答應？”
    寧采臣點點頭：“說來聽聽。”
    小倩低著頭，哭著說：“我被樹妖威脅，幹了許多壞事。我沒有辦法救我自己，但公子你是一個正直的人，你一定能救我。”
    “我很想救你，但我只是一個普普通通的人，我要怎麼做才能救你呢？”寧采臣覺得小倩很可憐。
    小倩說：“如果你能把我的墳帶到別處，我就不用受到樹妖的威脅了。我的墳就在這寺廟的北面。”
    寧采臣答應了。小倩很感激地看著寧采臣，轉身走了。
    第二天，寧采臣請燕赤霞去喝酒，並請求晚上和他住在一起。燕赤霞剛開始不同意，但經不住寧采臣一而再再而三的苦苦請求，只好同意了。
    晚上，寧采臣來到燕赤霞的房間。燕赤霞對他說：“寧公子，我知道你是一個正直的人。您想和我住，可以。但我希望你不要碰這個小箱子，否則，對你對我都不好。”寧采臣答應了。
    燕赤霞把這個帶鎖的小箱子放在窗邊，就去睡覺了，不一會兒，就睡著了。而寧采臣因為害怕，怎麼也睡不著。到了晚上九點，窗戶上出現了一個巨大的影子。慢慢地，影子越來越近了。
（未完待續）

sentences.traditional: 燕赤霞剛開始不同意，但經不住寧采臣一而再再而三的苦苦請求，
sentences.pinyin: yān chì xiá gāng kāi shǐ bù tóng yì dàn jīng bu zhù nìng cǎi chén yī ér zài zài ér sān de kǔ kǔ qǐng qiú
sentences.english: Yan Chixia didn’t agree in the beginning, but couldn’t bear Ning Caichen persistently asking again and again, ..

sentences.simplified: 只好同意了。
sentences.traditional: 只好同意了。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ hǎo tóng yì le
sentences.english: .. and was forced to agree.

sentences.simplified: 晚上，宁采臣来到燕赤霞的房间。
sentences.traditional: 晚上，寧采臣來到燕赤霞的房間。
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shang nìng cǎi chén lái dào yān chì xiá de fáng jiān
sentences.english: In the evening, Ning Caichen came to Yan Chixia’s room.

sentences.simplified: 燕赤霞对他说：“宁公子，我知道你是一个正直的人。您想和我住，可以。
sentences.traditional: 燕赤霞對他說：“寧公子，我知道你是一個正直的人。您想和我住，可以。
sentences.pinyin: yān chì xiá duì tā shuō nìng gōng zǐ wǒ zhī dào nǐ shì yí ge zhèng zhí de rén nín xiǎng hé wǒ zhù kě yǐ
sentences.english: Yan Chixia said to him: “Son of Ning, I know that you’re an upright person. You want to stay with me, you can.”

sentences.simplified: 但我希望你不要碰这个小箱子，否则，对你对我都不好。”
sentences.traditional: 但我希望你不要碰這個小箱子，否則，對你對我都不好。”
sentences.pinyin: dàn wǒ xī wàng nǐ bú yào pèng zhè ge xiǎo xiāng zi fǒu zé duì nǐ duì wǒ dōu bù hǎo
sentences.english: “But I wish that you don’t touch this small box. Otherwise, it will be bad for both you and me.”

sentences.simplified: 宁采臣答应了。
sentences.traditional: 寧采臣答應了。
sentences.pinyin: nìng cǎi chén dā ying le
sentences.english: Ning Caichen agreed.

sentences.simplified: 燕赤霞把这个带锁的小箱子放在窗边，就去睡觉了，不一会儿，就睡着了。
sentences.traditional: 燕赤霞把這個帶鎖的小箱子放在窗邊，就去睡覺了，不一會兒，就睡著了。
sentences.pinyin: yān chì xiá bǎ zhè ge dài suǒ de xiǎo xiāng zi fàng zài chuāng biān jiù qù shuì jiào le bù yí huì'r jiù shuì zháo le
sentences.english: Yan Chixia put the small box with a lock by the window, went to bed, and not long after, he fell asleep.

sentences.simplified: 而宁采臣因为害怕，怎么也睡不着。
sentences.traditional: 而寧采臣因為害怕，怎麼也睡不著。
sentences.pinyin: ér nìng cǎi chén yīn wèi hài pà zěn me yě shuì bù zháo
sentences.english: But because Ning Caichen was afraid, he couldn’t fall asleep at all.

sentences.simplified: 到了晚上九点，窗户上出现了一个巨大的影子。
sentences.traditional: 到了晚上九點，窗戶上出現了一個巨大的影子。
sentences.pinyin: dào le wǎn shang jiǔ diǎn chuāng hu shang chū xiàn le yí ge jù dà de yǐng zi
sentences.english: It became nine o’clock at night, and a huge shadow appeared on the window.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地，影子越来越近了。
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地，影子越來越近了。
sentences.pinyin: màn man de yǐng zi yuè lái yuè jìn le
sentences.english: Slowly, the shadow came closer and closer.

sentences.simplified: （未完待续）
sentences.traditional: （未完待續）
sentences.pinyin: wèi wán dài xù
sentences.english: (To be continued)

raw.synopsis: This is the second part of our rendition of Pu SongLing’s short story “Nie Xiaoqian”.
sentence_translations: Xiao Qian (Part 2)
Ning Caichen asked Yan Chixia if he knew about their cause of death.
Yan Chixia believed that it was the doings of a ghost.
Ning Caichen was of upright character, and he really didn’t believe in ghosts, ..
.. and so he didn’t take Yan Chixia’s words to heart.
At night, Xiao Qian came looking for Ning Caichen again.
She said to him: “I’ve met a lot of people, but I’ve never met someone as upright as you.”
“You really are a good person, I don’t dare deceive you. I’m not actually human, I’m a ghost.”
“I died of illness when I was 18 years old, and my grave is beside this temple.”
“I am threatened by a tree demon here. He wants me to go and decieve other people using my good looks,” ..
.. “and then kill them, to get their blood for him to drink.”
“I really don’t want to harm anyone at all. I’m threatened to it by the tree demon.”
“Now there’s only you and Yan Chixia left in this temple. It’s very possible that the tree demon will come to kill you!”
Ning Caichen was so scared that he kept trembling after hearing this. He asked Xiao Qian what he should do.
Xiao Qian said: “You just need to go stay together with Yan Chixia, and nothing will happen.”
Ning Caichen thought that was very strange: “Why haven’t you gone to decieve Yan Chixia?”
“He’s an odd person, I don’t dare go near him.” Xiao Qian said in reply.
“How do you decieve people?” Ning Caichen seemed to have an endless amount of questions.
Xiao Qian said: “Men who lust for women, I just use my good looks to decieve.”
“Then I use an awl to prick his foot, to get his blood and give it to the tree demon to drink.”
“People who like money, I give gold to. It’s actually not gold, it can take people’s hearts.”
Ning Caichen shook even more seriously after hearing this, and hurriedly asked: “When will the tree demon come?”
“Tomorrow night.” Xiao Qian paused for a bit, and then continued saying:
“Son of an official, I have a very small request, and don’t know whether or not you’ll agree?”
Ning Caichen nodded: “Let me hear it.”
Xiao Qian said while crying with her head lowered: “Under the threat of the tree demon, I have done many bad things.”
“I don’t have a way to save myself, but you, son of an official, are an upright person, you’ll certainly be able to save me.”
“I really want to save you, but I’m just an ordinary person, what could I do to save you?”
Ning Caichen thought that Xiao Qian was very pitiful.
Xiao Qian said:
“If you can take my grave and bring it somewhere else, then I wouldn’t have to be threatened by the tree demon.”
“My grave is to the north of this temple.”
Ning Caichen agreed.
Xiao Qian looked at Ning Caichen very gratefully, turned around and left.
The next day, Ning Caichen invited Yan Chixia to go drinking, ..
.. and also requested to stay together with him in the evening.
Yan Chixia didn’t agree in the beginning, but couldn’t bear Ning Caichen persistently asking again and again, ..
.. and was forced to agree.
In the evening, Ning Caichen came to Yan Chixia’s room.
Yan Chixia said to him: “Son of Ning, I know that you’re an upright person. You want to stay with me, you can.”
“But I wish that you don’t touch this small box. Otherwise, it will be bad for both you and me.”
Ning Caichen agreed.
Yan Chixia put the small box with a lock by the window, went to bed, and not long after, he fell asleep.
But because Ning Caichen was afraid, he couldn’t fall asleep at all.
It became nine o’clock at night, and a huge shadow appeared on the window.
Slowly, the shadow came closer and closer.
(To be continued)
